# Delivery and refunds

## Delivery
We deliver through LINE MAN and Grab Food within 5 km of the shop, 09:00–17:00. Orders over 300 baht placed directly in this chat get free delivery within 3 km; otherwise delivery is 40 baht. Coffee beans ship nationwide by Kerry Express in 1–3 days, 50 baht per order, free over 1,000 baht.

## Refunds and complaints
If a drink is wrong or spilled on delivery, send a photo in this chat within 1 hour and we remake it for free or refund to the original payment method within 7 days. Coffee beans can be returned unopened within 14 days. We do not refund change-of-mind orders for drinks or cakes.
